sources.quote: Zeta Leporis, Latinized from ζ Leporis formally named Darlugal, is a star approximately 70.5 light-years away in the southern constellation of Lepus.

introduction.text: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 13 times the Sun's luminosity at 7,737 K, so 2.017 solar radii.
